description: Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets (prediction markets on sports, central bank decisions, IPOs and daily BTC price contracts) over the last 4 hours, 1 day or 1 week: traded volume (each trade counted once), fills, wallets and active markets, plus the most traded outcomes with their last traded price (the implied probability, 0 to 1) and last-24-hour traded volume. Each outcome has a Yes and a No side whose prices sum to 1. For one outcome's trades or candles pass its symbol to get_recent_trades or get_candles; settled outcomes stay queryable. For per-wallet outcome activity use run_query on hl.wallet_daily with market_class = 'prediction'.

limit.description: Number of outcomes to return, most traded first (1-200, default 20)

name: get_outcome_markets

computed_at.description: When the summary was computed, Unix seconds

fills_total.description: Fill rows over the window, both sides of each trade plus settlements, splits and merges

markets_active.description: Outcome sides with a fill in the window

notice.description: A note from the API: how a market name was read, why data starts later than asked, or a next step such as a free key

notional_total.description: Not traded volume: USD over every fill row, both sides of each trade plus settlements, splits and merges. Use volume_usd

top_markets.description: Most traded outcome sides, highest 24h traded volume first

fills_24h.description: Fill rows in the last 24 hours

last_fill_ms.description: Last fill of any kind, Unix milliseconds

last_price.description: Last traded price, the implied probability (0 to 1); null when this side had no trade in 24 hours

last_trade_price.description: Same as last_price, 0 when this side had no trade in 24 hours

notional_24h.description: Not traded volume: USD over every fill row of this side in 24 hours. Use volume_24h

volume_24h.description: Traded volume in USD on this side in the last 24 hours, each trade once. The two sides of an outcome share one book: add both for the outcome's volume

volume_usd.description: Traded volume in USD over the window, each trade counted once

wallets_total.description: Wallets with any fill over the window, including wallets that only settled, split or merged

window_hours.description: Window of the totals, in hours

title: HIP-4 outcome markets overview
